title: Rockefeller Tracked Every Cent at 16 📒

scenes.say: At sixteen, the future richest man in America wrote down every cent he spent.
Cleveland, eighteen fifty-five. His first job paid fifty dollars for three months.
Into a cheap notebook went his meals, his laundry, and a penny every Sunday for Sunday school.
Forty-two years later, he said he would not trade it for all the ledgers in New York.
So how did a clerk on fifty cents a day get that rich?

first_comment: Would you write down every cent you spend for one month? 👇
